objectives.statement: Understand foundational mental models and syntax of Cybersecurity
Implement reliable patterns and error handling in Cybersecurity
Apply Cybersecurity in production-ready real-world scenarios
Evaluate security, performance, and best practices for Cybersecurity

prerequisites: Basic digital literacy and analytical reasoning

modules.title: Module 1: Foundations & Core Concepts of Cybersecurity
modules.summary: Explore the fundamental concepts, terminology, and development workflow.
lessonTitles: Core Syntax and Primitives in Cybersecurity
modules.checkpoint: Build a functional baseline demonstration verifying syntax and flow.

modules.title: Module 2: Practical Implementation & Production Patterns
modules.summary: Deep dive into resilient design, test automation, and real-world deployment.
lessonTitles: Production Patterns and Resilience in Cybersecurity
modules.checkpoint: Complete a verifiable project applying defense-in-depth principles.

practiceActivities: Hands-on coding labs for each core topic
projects: Production-ready Cybersecurity portfolio module with automated test suite and documentation
proficiencyCriteria: Demonstrate 70%+ score on all concept knowledge checks
Submit verifiable implementation satisfying acceptance criteria
